/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short --branch && sed -n '1,220p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.beforeSession.acceptance.test.ts && sed -n '1,260p' specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md && sed -n '1,120p' CHANGELOG.md && sed -n '1,220p' .lore/test-commands.yml && rg -n 'PromptBuilderConfig|baseSystemPrompt|validated by|specs/' src/orchestration specs/hal-engine-config-hooks package.json"
